library_name: Fuzi Elevators WhatsApp Business Template Library
format_notes: Submit each item as a WhatsApp Business message template with one BODY component.
One Discord channel can map to multiple event templates; template names combine channel context and event purpose.
Breakdown Discord templates mirror the actual FUZI formatter shapes in server/index.mjs.
Meta categories are UTILITY for operational notifications and MARKETING only for review/referral outreach.
